text: The AlterIndexTogether migration operation is now officially supported only for pre-Django 4.2 migration files. For backward compatibility reasons, it's still part of the public API, and there's no plan to deprecate or remove it, but it should not be used for new migrations. Use django.db.migrations.operations.AddIndex and django.db.migrations.operations.RemoveIndex operations instead.
suggestion_reason: New migrations should use AddIndex or RemoveIndex instead of AlterIndexTogether.

text: The new Sitemap.get_languages_for_item method allows customizing the list of languages for which the item is displayed.
suggestion_reason: Sitemap language selection changes which item versions appear in output.

text: During the deprecation period string literals will be attempted to be JSON decoded and a warning will be emitted on success that points at passing non-encoded forms instead.
suggestion_reason: JSONField string-literal decoding changes database lookup semantics.

text: django.contrib.auth.forms.UserCreationForm now rejects usernames that differ only in case. If you need the previous behavior, use django.contrib.auth.forms.BaseUserCreationForm instead.
suggestion_reason: UserCreationForm validation rejects case-only username differences.

text: The GeoJSON serializer now outputs the id key for serialized features, which defaults to the primary key of objects.
suggestion_reason: The GeoJSON serializer now emits an id key.

text: The django.core.files.storage.get_storage_class() function is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Code calling get_storage_class needs a replacement.

text: The chosen options of django.contrib.admin.ModelAdmin.filter_horizontal and django.contrib.admin.ModelAdmin.filter_vertical widgets are now filterable.
suggestion_reason: Admin filter widgets now let users filter chosen options.

text: The new KT() expression represents the text value of a key, index, or path transform of django.db.models.JSONField.
suggestion_reason: KT changes JSONField key and path query expressions.

text: The new ManifestStaticFilesStorage.manifest_hash attribute provides a hash over all files in the manifest and changes whenever one of the files changes.
suggestion_reason: Code can read the new manifest_hash attribute.

text: The private internal vendored copy of urllib.parse.urlsplit() now strips '\r', '\n', and '\t' (see 2022-0391 and 43882). This is to protect projects that may be incorrectly using the internal url_has_allowed_host_and_scheme() function, instead of using one of the documented functions for handling URL redirects. The Django functions were not affected.
suggestion_reason: Projects using the private URL validation helper may see different input handling.

text: Session cookies are now treated as credentials and therefore hidden and replaced with stars (**********) in error reports.
suggestion_reason: Error reports now mask session cookie values.

text: The new django.core.files.storage.InMemoryStorage class provides a non-persistent storage useful for speeding up tests by avoiding disk access.
suggestion_reason: Tests can configure the new nonpersistent storage backend.

text: Support for psycopg2 is likely to be deprecated and removed at some point in the future.
suggestion_reason: This predicts a possible future psycopg2 deprecation but states no current behavior to verify.

text: django.forms.models.modelform_factory now respects the formfield_callback attribute of the form’s Meta.
suggestion_reason: Code using modelform_factory may observe its Meta callback being honored.

text: django.contrib.gis.forms.widgets.OpenLayersWidget is now based on OpenLayers 7.2.2 (previously 4.6.5).
suggestion_reason: The GIS form widget now uses a newer OpenLayers interface.

text: The minimum supported version of Pillow is increased from 6.2.0 to 6.2.1.
suggestion_reason: The installed Pillow minimum version has increased.

text: {% blocktranslate asvar … %}<blocktranslate> result is now marked as safe for (HTML) output purposes.
suggestion_reason: Block translation output is now marked HTML-safe.

text: The alias argument for Expression.get_group_by_cols is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code passing alias to Expression.get_group_by_cols must change.

text: The undocumented django.http.multipartparser.parse_header() function is removed. Use django.utils.http.parse_header_parameters() instead.
suggestion_reason: Code calling the removed parse_header helper must use its replacement.

text: Related managers now provide asynchronous versions of methods that change a set of related objects, using an a prefix: RelatedManager.aadd, RelatedManager.aclear, RelatedManager.aremove, and RelatedManager.aset.
suggestion_reason: Code can call new asynchronous related-manager methods.

text: The is_summary argument of the undocumented Query.add_annotation() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code passing is_summary to Query.add_annotation must change.

text: Passing positional arguments to Signer and TimestampSigner is deprecated in favor of keyword-only arguments.
suggestion_reason: Signer and TimestampSigner calls should use keyword arguments.

text: The minimum supported version of jinja2 is increased from 2.9.2 to 2.11.0.
suggestion_reason: The installed Jinja2 minimum version has increased.

text: Manually instantiated WSGIRequest objects must be provided a file-like object for wsgi.input. Previously, Django was more lax than the expected behavior as specified by the WSGI specification.
suggestion_reason: Manual WSGIRequest construction must pass a file-like wsgi.input.

text: Registering lookups on django.db.models.Field instances is now supported.
suggestion_reason: Custom code can register lookups on Field instances.

text: TransactionTestCase.assertQuerysetEqual() is deprecated in favor of assertQuerySetEqual().
suggestion_reason: Tests should call assertQuerySetEqual instead of its deprecated spelling.

text: The django.contrib.auth.hashers.CryptPasswordHasher is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code importing the removed password hasher must change.

text: The get_prefetch_queryset() method of related managers and descriptors is deprecated. Starting with Django 6.0, get_prefetcher() and prefetch_related_objects() will no longer fallback to get_prefetch_queryset(). Subclasses should implement get_prefetch_querysets() instead.
suggestion_reason: Custom related managers should implement get_prefetch_querysets.

text: django.db.models.functions.Now database function now uses LOCALTIMESTAMP instead of CURRENT_TIMESTAMP on Oracle.
suggestion_reason: Now() produces different Oracle timestamp query semantics.

text: Form fields now include the aria-describedby HTML attribute to enable screen readers to associate form fields with their help text.
suggestion_reason: Rendered form fields now include aria-describedby for help text.

text: QuerySet.aiterator now supports previous calls to prefetch_related().
suggestion_reason: aiterator now supports prefetch-related ORM query behavior.

text: The undocumented ability to pass errors=None to SimpleTestCase.assertFormError() and assertFormsetError() is removed.
suggestion_reason: Tests passing errors=None to these assertion helpers must change.

text: The ability to return a str, rather than a SafeString, when rendering an ErrorDict and ErrorList is removed.
suggestion_reason: ErrorDict and ErrorList render with a SafeString result.

text: The "django/forms/default.html" and "django/forms/formsets/default.html" templates are removed.
suggestion_reason: The removed form templates affect rendered form output.

text: The default form and formset rendering style is changed to the div-based.
suggestion_reason: Default form and formset output is now div-based.

text: The ForeignObject.get_reverse_joining_columns() method is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Custom ForeignObject code should stop using get_reverse_joining_columns.

text: The name argument of django.utils.functional.cached_property() is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code passing name to cached_property must change.

text: The force_insert argument of Model.save now allows specifying a tuple of parent classes that must be forced to be inserted.
suggestion_reason: Model.save force_insert changes how parent rows are inserted.

text: django.core.exceptions.BadRequest is raised for non-UTF-8 encoded requests with the application/x-www-form-urlencoded content type. See 1866 for more details.
suggestion_reason: Non-UTF-8 form requests now produce a BadRequest response.

text: AdminSite.site_header is now rendered in a <div> tag instead of <h1>. Screen reader users rely on heading elements for navigation within a page. Having two <h1> elements was confusing and the site header wasn't helpful as it is repeated on all pages.
suggestion_reason: The admin site header now renders as a div rather than h1.

text: The new UniqueConstraint.nulls_distinct attribute allows customizing the treatment of NULL values on PostgreSQL 15+.
suggestion_reason: UniqueConstraint changes database NULL uniqueness behavior.

text: The django.contrib.postgres.aggregates.ArrayAgg, JSONBAgg, and StringAgg aggregates no longer return [], [], and '', respectively, when there are no rows.
suggestion_reason: The aggregates now return different values for empty result sets.

text: django.contrib.sessions.serializers.PickleSerializer is removed.
suggestion_reason: Session serializer configuration cannot reference removed PickleSerializer.

text: The undocumented Query.annotation_select_mask attribute is changed from a set of strings to an ordered list of strings.
suggestion_reason: Custom code reading Query.annotation_select_mask sees an ordered list.

text: The django.utils.timezone.utc alias to datetime.timezone.utc is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code importing the removed timezone.utc alias must change.

text: The undocumented django.utils.datetime_safe module is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code importing the undocumented datetime_safe module must change.

text: The default sitemap protocol for sitemaps built outside the context of a request is changed from 'http' to 'https'.
suggestion_reason: Generated sitemap URLs now default to HTTPS outside a request.

text: The USE_DEPRECATED_PYTZ transitional setting is removed.
suggestion_reason: The removed USE_DEPRECATED_PYTZ setting requires configuration review.

text: created=True is required in the signature of RemoteUserBackend.configure_user() subclasses.
suggestion_reason: RemoteUserBackend subclasses need a created parameter in configure_user.

text: ImageField.update_dimension_fields() is no longer called on the post_init signal if width_field and height_field are not set.
suggestion_reason: ImageField no longer refreshes dimension fields on post_init in this case.

text: Executing SQL queries before the app registry has been fully populated now raises RuntimeWarning.
suggestion_reason: Startup code that queries before app registry readiness now triggers a warning.

text: The opclasses argument of django.contrib.postgres.constraints.ExclusionConstraint is removed.
suggestion_reason: Constraint construction code cannot pass opclasses.

text: The extra_tests argument for DiscoverRunner.build_suite() and DiscoverRunner.run_tests() is removed.
suggestion_reason: Custom test-runner calls cannot pass extra_tests.

text: The Prefetch.get_current_queryset() method is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Code using Prefetch.get_current_queryset should migrate.

text: Django now supports oracledb version 1.3.2 or higher. Support for cx_Oracle is deprecated as of this release and will be removed in Django 6.0.
suggestion_reason: Oracle driver dependency support changes at deployment.

text: Support for logging out via GET requests in the django.contrib.auth.views.LogoutView and django.contrib.auth.views.logout_then_login() is removed.
suggestion_reason: GET requests can no longer log users out through these views.

text: The instance argument of the undocumented BaseModelFormSet.save_existing() method is renamed to obj.
suggestion_reason: Custom formset code must use the renamed obj parameter.

text: Support for calling format_html() without passing args or kwargs is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: format_html calls need args or kwargs.

text: Setting django.contrib.gis.gdal.OGRGeometry.coord_dim is deprecated. Use django.contrib.gis.gdal.OGRGeometry.set_3d instead.
suggestion_reason: GIS code should call set_3d instead of setting coord_dim.

text: ImageField.update_dimension_fields(force=True) is no longer called after saving the image to storage. If your storage backend resizes images, the width_field and height_field will not match the width and height of the image.
suggestion_reason: Stored image dimensions can now differ after a resizing storage backend runs.

text: The map_width and map_height attributes of BaseGeometryWidget are removed.
suggestion_reason: Custom geometry-widget code cannot use removed sizing attributes.

text: F() and OuterRef() expressions that output django.db.models.CharField, django.db.models.EmailField, django.db.models.SlugField, django.db.models.URLField, django.db.models.TextField, or django.contrib.postgres.fields.ArrayField can now be sliced.
suggestion_reason: Sliced F and OuterRef expressions change ORM query capabilities.

text: django.contrib.auth.decorators.login_required, django.contrib.auth.decorators.permission_required, and django.contrib.auth.decorators.user_passes_test decorators now support wrapping asynchronous view functions.
suggestion_reason: Authentication decorators can wrap async view code.

text: django.contrib.gis.measure.Area now supports the ha unit.
suggestion_reason: GIS code can use the ha area unit.

text: In order to improve accessibility, the admin's footer is now rendered in a <footer> tag instead of a <div>, and also moved below the <div id="main"> element.
suggestion_reason: The admin footer moves and renders as a footer element.

text: The undocumented django.utils.itercompat.is_iterable() function and the django.utils.itercompat module are deprecated. Use isinstance(..., collections.abc.Iterable) instead.
suggestion_reason: Code using the deprecated is_iterable helper should use Iterable checks.

text: The undocumented OS_OPEN_FLAGS property of django.core.files.storage.FileSystemStorage is deprecated. To allow overwriting files in storage, set the new django.core.files.storage.FileSystemStorage.allow_overwrite option to True instead.
suggestion_reason: Storage overwrite behavior should use the new allow_overwrite option.

text: The get_cache_name() method of FieldCacheMixin is deprecated in favor of the cache_name cached property.
suggestion_reason: FieldCacheMixin code should use cache_name instead.

text: The undocumented django.urls.converters.get_converter() function is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code importing the removed get_converter helper must change.

text: To improve performance, the delete_selected admin action now uses QuerySet.bulk_create() when creating multiple LogEntry objects. As a result, pre_save and post_save signals for LogEntry are not sent when multiple objects are deleted via this admin action.
suggestion_reason: LogEntry signal handlers no longer run for bulk admin deletion.

text: Support for passing positional arguments to BaseConstraint is removed.
suggestion_reason: BaseConstraint construction can no longer use positional arguments.

text: The new geom_type lookup and GeometryType() database function allow filtering geometries by their types.
suggestion_reason: GIS geometry-type filtering changes database query capabilities.

text: Backends are configured via the TASKS setting. The two built-in backends included in this release are primarily intended for development and testing.
suggestion_reason: The TASKS setting selects a task backend.

text: The default protocol in urlize and urlizetrunc will change from HTTP to HTTPS in Django 7.0. Set the transitional setting URLIZE_ASSUME_HTTPS to True to opt into assuming HTTPS during the Django 6.x release cycle.
suggestion_reason: Projects can opt in through the URLIZE_ASSUME_HTTPS setting.

text: The new django.db.models.StringAgg aggregate returns the input values concatenated into a string, separated by the delimiter string. This aggregate was previously supported only for PostgreSQL.
suggestion_reason: StringAgg changes database aggregation output.

text: The Font Awesome Free icon set (version 6.7.2) is now used for the admin interface icons.
suggestion_reason: Admin interface icons now use a different icon set.

text: DatabaseOperations.return_insert_columns() and DatabaseOperations.fetch_returned_insert_rows() methods are renamed to returning_columns() and fetch_returned_rows(), respectively, to denote they can be used in the context of UPDATE … RETURNING statements as well as INSERT … RETURNING.
suggestion_reason: Custom database backend methods must use their new names.

text: The CreateExtension, BloomExtension, BtreeGinExtension, BtreeGistExtension, CITextExtension, CryptoExtension, HStoreExtension, TrigramExtension, and UnaccentExtension operations now support the optional hints parameter. This allows providing database hints to database routers to assist them in making routing decisions.
suggestion_reason: Extension migration operations gain database-router hints.

text: The django.contrib.gis.geoip2.GeoIP2.open() method is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code calling GeoIP2.open must change.

text: The FORMS_URLFIELD_ASSUME_HTTPS transitional setting is removed.
suggestion_reason: The transitional HTTPS URL-field setting is removed.

text: The check keyword argument of CheckConstraint is removed.
suggestion_reason: CheckConstraint construction cannot use the check keyword.

text: The new django.contrib.gis.db.models.functions.Rotate database function rotates a geometry by a specified angle around the origin or a specified point.
suggestion_reason: The Rotate function changes GIS database query output.

text: The ChoicesMeta alias to django.db.models.enums.ChoicesType is removed.
suggestion_reason: Code importing ChoicesMeta must use ChoicesType.

text: The django.db.models.sql.datastructures.Join no longer falls back to get_joining_columns().
suggestion_reason: Custom Join code cannot rely on get_joining_columns fallback.

text: The PostgreSQL OrderableAggMixin is deprecated in favor of the order_by attribute now available on the django.db.models.Aggregate class.
suggestion_reason: Custom aggregates should move from OrderableAggMixin to order_by.

text: The django.db.models.Model.save method now raises a specialized Model.NotUpdated exception, when a forced update results in no affected rows, instead of a generic django.db.DatabaseError.
suggestion_reason: Callers catching DatabaseError should handle Model.NotUpdated.

text: get_prefetcher() and prefetch_related_objects() no longer fall back to get_prefetch_queryset().
suggestion_reason: Custom prefetch code must implement the newer queryset method.

text: Using a ForeignObject with multiple from_fields in Model indexes, constraints, or unique_together now emits a system check error.
suggestion_reason: Model indexes and constraints using this ForeignObject pattern now fail a system check.

text: The django.core.mail.SafeMIMEText and SafeMIMEMultipart classes are deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Code importing deprecated SafeMIME classes needs review.

text: QuerySet.raw now supports models with a django.db.models.CompositePrimaryKey.
suggestion_reason: QuerySet.raw can now work with composite primary-key models.

text: Django handles task creation and queuing, but does not provide a worker mechanism to run tasks. Execution must be managed by external infrastructure, such as a separate process or service.
suggestion_reason: Background task execution requires an external worker service.

text: request is required in the signature of ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed() subclasses.
suggestion_reason: ModelAdmin.lookup_allowed subclass signatures must accept request.

text: django.db.models.GeneratedField\s and fields assigned expressions are now refreshed from the database after django.db.models.Model.save on backends that support the RETURNING clause (SQLite, PostgreSQL, and Oracle). On backends that don't support it (MySQL and MariaDB), the fields are marked as deferred to trigger a refresh on subsequent accesses.
suggestion_reason: Generated fields refresh from the database differently after save.

text: The OS_OPEN_FLAGS attribute of django.core.files.storage.FileSystemStorage is removed.
suggestion_reason: Storage subclass code using OS_OPEN_FLAGS must change.

text: The django.core.mail.BadHeaderError exception is deprecated. Python's modern email raises a !ValueError for email headers containing prohibited characters.
suggestion_reason: Email header validation now raises ValueError rather than BadHeaderError.

text: Subqueries returning a django.db.models.CompositePrimaryKey can now be used as the target of lookups other than __in, such as __exact.
suggestion_reason: Composite-key subqueries now work with additional ORM lookups.

text: Support for passing positional arguments to Model.save() and Model.asave() is removed.
suggestion_reason: Model.save and asave calls can no longer use positional arguments.

text: The get_cache_name() method of FieldCacheMixin is removed.
suggestion_reason: FieldCacheMixin callers cannot use get_cache_name.

text: The undocumented django.core.mail.forbid_multi_line_headers() and django.core.mail.message.sanitize_address() functions are deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Code calling deprecated mail header helpers needs review.

text: Support for the orphans argument being larger than or equal to the per_page argument of django.core.paginator.Paginator and django.core.paginator.AsyncPaginator is deprecated.
suggestion_reason: Paginator construction must avoid this deprecated orphans value.
